import urllib.request, hashlib, os, time
U = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/volodymyr-holovan/wilds-and-wanderers/4c01ed3e28c9b2157dd1dae95ecffa59a5f5d7a7/pack/server/night_shutdown.py'
H = 'e45bf4347aed44f7aba8f3ce1a8b58606eae177a65bcb142b027d28fb8ddcb31'
C = '/data/night_shutdown.py'
os.makedirs('/data', exist_ok=True)
d = open(C, 'rb').read() if os.path.exists(C) else b''
if hashlib.sha256(d).hexdigest() != H:
    for i in range(60):
        try:
            d = urllib.request.urlopen(U, timeout=30).read()
            break
        except Exception as e:
            print('download failed, retry:', e, flush=True)
            time.sleep(10)
    if hashlib.sha256(d).hexdigest() != H:
        raise SystemExit('night_shutdown.py: checksum mismatch, not running it')
    open(C, 'wb').write(d)
exec(compile(d, C, 'exec'), {'__name__': '__main__'})
